title: DecepGPT: Schema-Driven Deception Detection with Multicultural Datasets and Robust Multimodal Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-cultural robustness by training multimodal deception detection models on data from a specific source culture (U.S., Germany, Vietnam, or Bulgaria) and testing their zero-shot transfer performance (Accuracy and F1 Score) on target data from different cultures to measure performance degradation.
